Plot catches

plot_catch.Rd

Plot catches

Usage

plot_catch(
  fit,
  type = "stock",
  biomass = TRUE,
  base_size = 8,
  return_data = FALSE
)

Arguments

fit

A gadget fit object. See g3_fit.

type

Character specifying the data type: "stock" plots the catches by stock, "fleet" by fleet, "total" catches without separating to stock or fleet, and "hr" harvest rates by fleet.

biomass

Logical indicating whether biomass should be plotted instead of estimated abundance.

base_size

Base size parameter for ggplot. See ggtheme.

return_data

Logical indicating whether to return data for the plot instead of the plot itself.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data(fit)
plot_catch(fit)

plot_catch(fit, biomass = FALSE)

plot_catch(fit, type = "total")
#> Ignoring unknown labels:
#> • fill : "Stock"

plot_catch(fit, type = "fleet")

plot_catch(fit, type = "hr")
